citations.title: Hover | GenAI Notice
excerpts: Hover’s GenAI uses custom generative AI technology in combination with pre-trained publicly accessible generative AI technologies in accordance with their respective licenses. The Hover GenAI Dataset is used in further development and/or validation of other pre-trained publicly accessible generative AI technologies.

These other technologies are described in more detail at the following publicly accessible links: [Stable Diffusion](https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5) , [Realistic Vision](https://huggingface.co/SG161222/Realistic_Vision_V6.0_B1_noVAE) , [Metric3D](https://huggingface.co/zachL1/Metric3D) , [OneFormer](https://huggingface.co/shi-labs/oneformer_ade20k_swin_large) , [MLSD](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/sd-controlnet-mlsd) , and [NormalBAE](https://huggingface.co/lllyasviel/control_v11p_sd15_normalbae) .

The Hover GenAI Dataset is used to enhance the Hover GenAI as conditional control (a “ControlNet”) of other generative AI technologies, including to constrain geometry and enhance segmentation of input content. The types of data points in the Hover GenAI Dataset includes images of building structures, 3D models derived from such images, and semantic labels of the building structure as represented by an associated 3D model (such as “ridge line,” “eave,” and so on).

basis.reasoning: Hover’s GenAI disclosure describes custom generative AI plus pretrained public technologies and names six technologies, while it does not state a single provider.

The integration covers the whole Hover project inside your Salesforce workflows, from creating the job and capturing the property to measurements, inspections, and estimates.
